name: scshell
author: Mr.Un1k0d3r (RingZer0 Team)
comment: Lateral movement via ChangeServiceConfigA (SCShell BOF): point a service at a command line, start it, then restore the original binary path. Use --token/--user/--ticket to authenticate to the target with stolen or created credentials.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Hostname or IP of the target machine (e.g. DC01)

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Service whose binary path is swapped (e.g. defragsvc)

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Full command line to execute on the target, e.g. cmd.exe /c whoami
